request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT

layers.text: Add only dark markings on the hide: one big dark navy saddle patch, colour #131c3a, over the back and shoulders with a clean scalloped lower edge, and three wide dark navy bands across the tail. The amber-orange crest and back spikes stay exactly as they are, and two small amber-orange marks sit under the eye. Do not redraw anything. Keep the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, arms, legs, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
